senses.gloss:
Acyuta
--Saṁyamasatkṛti. yoga. Baroda 314.

Acyuta
a. astrologer of Serfoji's time; collaborator in Navagrahapadāni. TD. 11705.

Acyuta
--Yudhiṣṭhiravijayavyākhyā-Vijayadarśikā. MT. 3007. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1103, 158. Trav. Uni. 639B. 6066A.

Acyuta
poet eulogised by Abhirāmakāmākṣī in his Abhinavarāmābhyudaya. MT. 3489.

Acyuta
a Keralabrāhmaṇa.
--Devakerala or Keralajyotiṣa or Candrakalānāḍī or Candranāḍī. jy. Adyar II. p. 59a. MD. 13775-79. MT. 853a. 3322. 4056. Mentions three works of old, God Nārāyaṇa's Jyautiṣasaṁhitā, Bṛhaspati's Jātakaskandha an. Bhārgavamata; Acyuta's work is based on the last.

Acyuta
minister of Śivasiṁha or Śivasiddha of Mithilā (C. middle of 15th cent. A. D.; see IO. I, p. 875); father of Manodhara alias Ratnapāṇi (C. on Kāvyaprakāśa called Kāvyadarpaṇa) an. grandfather [Page073-a. of Ravipāṇi(Kāvyaprakāśaṭīkā-Madhumatī). MT. 1676. Peters. III. 333.

Acyuta
poet. Kvs. 413. Śp. 1108. 1185.

Acyuta
--Āyurvedasāra. Cited by Niścalakara in his C. on Cakrapāṇi's Cikitsāsaṁgraha, IHQ. XXIII. ii. p. 136.

Acyuta
med. a. Q. in Yogaratnasamuccaya of Anantakumāra, TSS. 152. II. p. 372.

Acyuta
--Kṛṣṇaśataka. stotra. Cabaton I. 677. Paris (D. 249).

Acyuta
son of Raghūttama.
--Ākāśaśataka. Pt.. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 16.

Acyuta
--Guruvaraprārthanāpañcaratnastotra. Bṛhatstotraratnākara, p. 299.

Acyuta
also called Bhaṭṭācārya Acyuta an. Mihirācārya Acyuta; son of Sāgara, son of Vāmana, of the Gautama gotra. In his Bhāsvatīkaraṇaṭīkā, gives calculations for A. D. 1505 an. 1534 (IO. 2918).
--Bhāvārthamañjarī, C. on the Jātakapaddhati of Śrīpati. Hpr. III. 101. RASB. 3950.
--Bhāsvatīratnamālā, C. on the Bhāsvatīkaraṇa of Śatānanda. AS. p. 311. IO. 2918.

Acyuta
son of Dharaṇi Goṇiga, son of Mahādeva, son of Soma, son of Hari, of the family of minister Nādiga, a Nāgara.
--Rasasaṅgrahasiddhānta. med. Weber 969.

Acyuta
mentioned a. a. a. in dharmaśāstra an. q. by Rāmanātha Vidyāvācaspati in his Dāyabhāgaviveka, C.. II. 159. [Page073-b]

Acyuta_Upādhyāya
--Amarakośaṭīkā, Vyākhyāpradīpa. BBRAS. 109. IO. 986-7. One ms. in Go7ttingen. Kielhorn 96. Mithilā. See also Colebrooke, Miscellaneous Essays III. p. 51.

Acyutakṛṣṇatīrtha
a guru of Mallaśāstrin (Sandhyādarpaṇavivaraṇa, MT. 2311).

Acyutakṛṣṇānandatīrtha
pupil of Svayamprakāśānanda Tīrtha, Sarvajña an. Advaitānanda Sarasvatī; lived in South India about 200 years ago.
--Kaṭhopaniṣadbhāṣyaṭīkā. Mysore I. p. 428.
--Chāndogyo1paniṣadvivaraṇa. Rice 52. Is it Chān. Up. Bhāṣya vivaraṇa ?
--Taittirīyopaniṣadbhāṣyavyākhyā-Vanamālā. CLB. I. p. 66. Mysore I. p. 433. Taylor II. 20. Ed.. Vāṇī Vilās Press.
--Brahmasūtrabhāṣya Bhāmatī vyākhyāBhāvadīpikā. Adyar II. p. 136b.
--Brahmasūtrabhāṣya Ratnaprabhā vyākhyāna. Adyar II. p. 135b. MT. 2782. Up. Br. Mutt 132 (inc.). 414. Pt.. Chowkhamba.
--Mānamālā. adv. tract in 46 verses giving briefly the scope of the six pramāṇas. Adyar II. p. 148b. Adyar D. IX. 1058.
Pt.. Adyar Library Pamphlet Ser. 26. 1951.
--Siddhāntaleśasaṅgrahavyākhyā-Kṛṣṇālaṅkāra. Pt.. Advaita Manjarī Ser., Kumbhakonam; Viz. Skt. Ser. 1. [Page074-a.

Acyutacakravarttin
son of Haridāsa Tarkācārya. C. 1500 A. D. See also JASB. (NS.) XI (1915) 362.
--Dāyabhāgavyākhyā-Siddhāntakumudacandrikā. Dacca 3261. IO. 1514. 1515. Mithilā I. 205. RASB. III. 2376. Sūcīpattra 29.
--Śrāddhavivekaṭippaṇī. Nabadwip 1014 (mentioned in his Dāyabhāgaṭīkā, IO. 1514).
--Hāralatāṭīkā-Sandarbhasūtikā. Dacca 4652. IO. 1753. SSPC. I. I. 100. Sūcīpattra 38.
Acyutānandacakravarttin of IO. 1515 an. Acyutacakravarttin of IO. 1514 are evidently the same though the beginnings of IO. 1514 an. 1515 differ.

Acyutacarita
kāvya in 15 cantos; by Gaṅgādāsa Mentioned by him in his own Chandomañjarī (Cal. Skt. Ser. XIV. 1935) in Ch.. I an. II an. a. the end.

Acyuta_Ṭhakkura
maternal grandfather of Raghudeva (Virudāvalī). Oxf. 133a. RASB. VI. 4941 (Vīravirudāvalī).

Acyutadhīra
son of Janārdana an. grandson of Puṣkara.
--Bhāvadīpikā. yoga. Hpr. IV. 201.

Acyutapāramyastotra
by Vīrarāghava. Oudh 1877, 56.

Acyutappiṣāraḍi
of Tirukkaṇṭiyūr in Kerala; pupil of Jyeṣṭhadeva an. teacher of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭatiri (Prakriyāsarvasva etc.); born probably in 1550 A. D. an. died in 1621 A. D. Patronised by king Ravivarma of Vettattunāḍ.
--Uparāgakriyākrama. jy. See NCC. II. p. 370b.
--Uparāgaviṁśati (?)
--Karaṇottama with C. jy. MT. 663 (a-b). TCD. 697b. [Page074-b]
--Chāyāṣṭaka. jy. (Dṛggaṇitakrama or Jyā-lāṭa-vaidhṛtagaṇitakrama).
--Praveśaka. gr. Ed.. Cochin Skt. Ser. 2.
--Rāśigolasphuṭānīti. Ed.. Adyar Libray Bulletin XVIII (1954) p.. 306-335.
--Veṇvāroha-vyākhyā in Malayalam.
--Sphuṭanirṇaya. MT. 3799 (b). Trav. Uni. L. 848B, C etc. Q. in Rāśigola.
--Horāsāroccaya. jy.
See JOR. Madras XXII. p.. 40-6; Adyar Library Bulletin XVIII (1954), p.. 306-335.

Acyutaprekṣācārya
guru of Ānandatīrtha. Bhr. p. 202.

Acyutamuni
cites Madhusūdana Sarasvatī an. his Siddhāntabindu.
--Advaitanirṇaya. MT. 2264.

Acyutayati
disciple of Madhusūdana.
--Sītārāmāṣṭakastotra. Pt.. in the Bṛhatstotraratnākara, p. 276.
--Hanumadaṣṭaka. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 24.

Acyutarāma
maternal grandfather of Veṅkaṭa (Prapañcadarpaṇa, MT. 2838).

Acyutarāmakṛṣṇākhyāh2
stotra. by Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa Ayyāvāl. Trav. Uni. 2890I. Ed.. J. of the Trav. Uni. Ori. Mss. Library.

Acyutarāya_Moḍaka
son of Nārāyaṇa an. Annapūrṇā; pupil of Ṣaṣṭi Nārāyaṇa (in Vedānta), who was pupil of Advaita Saccidānandendra Sarasvatī; initiated into Śivabhakti by Mahādeva; mentions another Guru, Raghūttamācārya in his Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti; wrote his Bhāgīrathīcampū in A. D. 1814; completed his C. on his own Sāhityasāra a. Pañcavaṭī in A. D. 1381; completed his Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti [Page075-a. a. the same place in A. D. 1819; completed his Mahārthamañjarī a. the same place in A. D. 1825. M. H. Khare, edn. of Moḍakakulavṛttānta, ascribes to him sixtytwo works. See also BDCRI. XVIII. 1957. p.. 215-220. But the list is uncritical.
--Akalpitacidambarīstotra. on Lakṣmī ? Q. in his Sahītyasāravākhyā, N. S. Press Ed.. of 1906, p. 312.
--Acyutaśataka, more correctly Nītiśatapatra. See below.
--Advaitajalajāta. Appears to have been written in collaboration with Pāṇḍuraṅga, son of his Guru, Nārāyaṇa; ref. to a. his work in his Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti an. a. Pāṇḍuraṅga's in Bh. 173. an. Mīm. Vid. 144. See below under Rāmagītācandrikā also.
--Advaitarājyalakṣmī, a C. on the Śaṅkaravijayasāra or Śaṅkaradigvijaya, ascribed to Mādhavācārya or Vidyāraṇya. Ms. with Bhai Sankar Shukla, Borsad, Kaira D..; also N. S. Press. 175. B. II. 134 (Auf. I. p.. 5b an. 684b) an. Adyar. Extracts from it are given in the Ānandāśrama Ed.. (No. XXII) of the Śaṅkaradigvijaya.
--Advaitavidyāvinoda. Nasik XXX. 12.
--Advaitādhikaraṇacintāmaṇimālā with C. Prakāśa. Mīm. Vid. 141. Q. also in his C. on the Jīvanmuktiviveka, Ānandāśrama Ed.. p.. 336. 351.
--Advaitāmṛtamañjarī with C. (in Āryās). Q. in his own Sāhityasāravyākhyā, p.. 283, 335, 373, 386, 390, 391, 392, 403, 415, 418, 437, 452, 461, 512, 524; an. in his C. on the Jīvanmuktiviveka, Ānandāśrama Ed.., p. 52.
Advaitamañjarī, Ratimukula, an. Ratinītimukula, BL. 91. 92. (Auf. [Page075-b] II. p. 2b), identical with Advaitāmṛtamañjarī. See Sāhityasāravyākhyā, p.. 381, 445-450.
--Avaidikamatatiraskāra. or Avaidikadhikkṛti. Khuperkar II. 1. This is also mentioned by him in his Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti, where it is said to have another name also, Śāktaśāsana. See BDCRI. XVIII. 1957. 215-220.
--Āryāsaptaśatī vyākhyā. Bomb. Uni. 2141.
--Īśadeśikavivecanamañjarī. Completed in A. D. 1835 (?). Mīm. Vid. 340.
--Kṛṣṇalīlāmṛta, kāvya, q. in his Sāhityasāravyākhyā, p.. 139, 288, 384, 397, 409, 419, 453, 456, 518, 524 (Pt.. with his own C. See Ori. Bk. Agency Cat. Poona.)
--Gītasītāpati (like the Gītagovinda). Q. in his Sāhityasāravyākhyā. p.. 384, 458.
--Godālaharī with C. Pt.. Gaṇapata Kṛṣṇāji Press, Bombay 1869.
--Jīvanmuktivivekavyākhyā-Pūrṇānandendukaumudī. Pt.. Ānandāśrama 20.
--Dṛśyaviṣayatākhaṇḍana an. C. adv. Baroda 12378.
--Nirañjanamañjarī, śāntarasakāvya. Q. in his Sāhityasāravyākhyā, p. 19.
--Nītiśatapatra (sometimes referred to also a. Acyutaśataka). Q. in his Sāhityasāravyākhyā, p.. 293, 307, 370, 386. 389, 392, 400, 404, 456. For mss. See Harshe 119 an. IO. 7225. Noted a. ptd. in the IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 25.
--Pañcadaśīvyākhyā-Pūrṇānandendukaumudī. Pt.. Poona 1895.
--Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti. Mysore I. p. 438. Finished in A. D. 1819 a. Pañcavaṭī. [Page076-a.
--Bodhaikyasiddhi with C. called Advaitātmabodha. Baroda 253. Also q. in his C. on the Jīvanmuktiviveka, p.. 216. 353.
--Bhāgīrathīcampū. Pt.. Grantharatnamālā II, III. 1888-9. For a ms. see BBRAS. 1252. Written in 1814 A. D.
--Bhāminīvilāsavyākhyā--Praṇayaprakāśa. Pt.. N. S. Press.
[--Matopanyāsa, BBRAS. 1160 is only part of C.. IV of the Sāhityasāra].
--Mahāvākyārthamañjarī. Adyar II. p. 148a. Adyar D. IX. 1054.
--Rāmagītācandrikā. BORI. 62 of 1907-15. Written in collaboration with his Guruputra Pāṇḍuraṅga; See above under Advaitajalajāta also.
--Viṣṇupadalakṣaṇā including Viṣṇupade ślokapañcaviṁśati. Ujjain Latest Additions 392.
--Vedāntāmṛtacidratnacaṣaka with C. Āmoda. B. IV. 96. Baroda 322. Jodhpur 1690.
--Sāhityasāra with C. Ed.. N. S. Press, 1906.
--Saubhāgyakalpadruma on Strīdharma. CLB. 1903. Same a. the work in Kane's HDS. I. p. 666b.
--Herambacaraṇāmṛtalaharī or Gaṇeśalaharī. stotra. BISM. thi. 932. thi. 1801. thi. 2036.
The following other works of the a. are noted by M. H. Khare in his Moḍakakulavṛttānta: Amarakośaṭīkā (Ist kāṇḍa). Amaruśatakaṭīkā-Arthadvayabodhinī. Duh2khakṣayendūdaya. Dvaitavyaktikṣaya. Bhāgavatacampū (may be a mistake). Revāpuruṣalaharī. Śṛṅgārakalikāṭīkā. Sadācāra with C. Sadāśivāryāvyākhyā. Saundaryalaharī [Page076-b] vyākhyā. Svapnamantratrayīvyākhyā. Haribhaktirasāmṛtasindhusāra.

Acyutarāyābhyudaya
mahākāvya in 12 cantos on Acyutarāya of Vijayanagar, A. D. 1529-30 to 1542-3 by Rājanātha Diṇḍima, son of Aruṇagirinātha.
Adyar II. p. 2a. Adyar D. V. 1. 2-4 (inc.). Burnell 156b. GD. 1674. Gough p. 144. MD. 11451. 12735 (fr.). MT. 4243c. Mysore I. p. 241 (11 cantos). Oppert I. 1375. 1734. II. 2710. TD. 4216. 4217. 4218 (10 cantos). 4219. Trav. Uni. 4530 (wants beg.). 12353. T. 1122. Viśvabhāratī 2177.
Ed.. Vāṇī Vilās Press, cantos 1-6 with a C.; rest in Adyar Library Ser. 49. 1945.
For Vyāsatīrtha an. Vallabhācarya a. the court of Acutarāya, see Annual Rep. on S. I. Epi. 1923, p.. 2. para 84.

Acyutalīlā
a Yamakakāvya by Vāsudeva, son of Gopālī an. Maharṣi. MT. 3060 (d). 3607 (d). See also J. of Trav. Uni. Ori. Mss. Lib. VI. p. 13.

Acyutaśataka
another name of the Nītiśatapatra of Acyutarāya Moḍak. See above.

Acyutaśataka
stotra in hundred Pkt. verses by Veṅkaṭanātha Vedāntadeśika.
Adyar I. p. 178a (4 mss.). GD. 1144A. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 2 (2 copies). IO. 7048. MD. 9816. 9817. 9818 (fr.). 10487 (inc.). MT. 366 (g). Mysore I. p. 209 (3 mss.). Taylor I. 146 (inc.).
Pt.. many times with glosses. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 25-6.

Acyutaśarman
--Rāmapūjāmantra. mantra. Adyar PL. p. 76.

Acyutastava
stotra. IM. 7123. [Page077-a.

Acyutākhyā_Rūpāvalī
by Kṛṣṇakavi. Pt.. Satara, 1872. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 25.

Acyutānanda
--Bhagavadgītāṭīkā. CPB. 3495.

Acyutānanda
pupil of Indravana an. Ānandagiri.
--Ekādaśīnirṇayavyākhyā, a C. on the 3 verses of Sureśvara an. the 3 verses of Śaṅkara on Ekādaśī. MT. 3395 (a.. Rice 82 (Auf. I. 5b), Ekādaśīmāhātmya ascribed to Acyutakṛṣṇānanda is probably identical with this.

Acyutānanda
--Ānandalaharīṭīkā. Pt.. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 94.

Acyutānandagiri
--Nīrājana. stotra. Bikaner 6304.

Acyutānandagosvāmin
Caitanya sect. son of Advaita.
--Utkaṇṭhāmaṇimālā.
--Gauragadādharāṣṭaka. Two works an. not only one work with two names a. Peterson (Alwar 1558) or Auf. (II. 186a an. 190b) took.
Alwar 1558. Extr. 379. MT. 3953 (a-64) the Gauragadādharāṣṭaka (also called Prabhoraṣṭaka).
--Yugalāṣṭaka. Varendra 1091.

Acyutānandaśarman
--Jātakakaumudī. jy. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1906, p. 4 (no. 1567).

Acyutāśrama_(?)
--Rāmārcanacandrikā ? K. 50. Is this Ānandavana's Rāmārcanacandrikā ?
--Viśveśvarīpaddhati. Baroda 12548. CPB. 5203. K. 192.
Is there a confusion here between Viśveśvara's Yatidharmasaṅgraha or Paddhati an. Acyutāśrama's Saṁnyāsidharmasaṅgraha [Page077-b] or Paddhati mentioned below ?

Acyutāśrama
--Pramāṇaratna. Bikaner 8956.

Acyutāśrama
--Prabodhabhānūdaya. adv. Bikaner 6455.

Acyutāśrama
pupil of Cidānandāśrama or Paramānandāśrama (BBRAS. 1154).
--Acyutāśramapaddhati or Saṁnyāsidharmasaṅgraha. Q. Yatidharmasamuccaya. Baroda 1940. 12057. Bikaner 2299 (Saṁnyāsapaddhati or Kuṭīcarasaṁskāra). Bomb. Uni. 1186 (Saṁnyāsapaddhati an. Saṁnyāsyantyeṣṭipaddhati). Hall p. 141. MT. 1736 (inc.).
--Rāmanāmamāhātmya. Alwar 1595. Extr. 400. BBRAS. 1154 (inc.). BORI. 54 of 1916-18 (Nāmasudhā is identical with this work). BORI. IX. ii. 390 (35 chs.). CPB. 2516. 4635. 4636. D. p. 287. IO. 3720. MD. 17876. Q. Śrīdharācārya an. Smṛtisamuccaya.
Acyutāśrama quotes the Kālanirṇayadīpikā of Rāmacandra, written before 1450 A. D.

Acyutāśramapaddhati
called also saMnyAsidharmasaGgraha Hall p. 141. Kavīndrācārya 1312. MT. 1736 (inc.).

Acyutāśramabhikṣu
--Svaprakāśapradīpikā. SB. 409.

Acyutāśramasvāmin
--Pañcadevastotra.
--Bhedabhaṅgābhidhastotra.
--Hariharādvaitastotra.
IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 26.

Acyutāśramin
--Vedāntasaṅgraha. MT. 2213 (c). [Page078-a.

Acyutāśraya(śrama_?)
guru of Jagajjīvana, a. of Brahmānandaprakāśikā on the Br. sūtras. Nasik VI. I.

Acyutāṣṭaka
a.. Adyar. America 1827. Ānandāśrama 6971 (1). CPB. 13. Rajapur 88. Trav. Uni. 3316C. L. 1234U. Varendra 1040.

Acyutāṣṭaka
stotra ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya. One of the following two stotras.
Adyar I. p.. 197b. 223a. AK. 107. AS. p. 2. Bikaner 6026. BISM. v.. 253/29. D. p. 450. DAVCL. 5024. Firenze 434. IM. 7488. 11251. MT. 7061. Pet. 726. Peters. VI. 262. Poona 593.

Acyutāṣṭaka
stotra ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya. Begins acyutaM kezavaM rAmanArAyaNam. Vāṇī Vilās Press Ed.. Śaṅkara's Works, Vol. 18. p.. 39-41; Bṛhatstotraratnākara, N. S. Press 2nd Ed.. p.. 144-5.
BORI. 262 of 1895-98. BORI. D. XIII. iii. 796. IO. 7049. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 55 (no. 490).

Acyutāṣṭaka
stotra ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya. Begins acyutAcyutahare paramAtman. BORI. 107 of 1891-95. 593 of Viś. (i). BORI. D. XIII. iii. 797-8.
Pt.. p.. 377-8, Śaṅkara's Works, Vol. IV, Ashtekar & C.., Poona.
Pt.. in the Bṛhatstotraratnākara, an. the Bṛhatstotramuktāhāra p.. 1. p.. 110-1.

Acyutendrābhyudaya
kāvya on the life of King Acyutappa Nāyak of Tanjore (1561-1614); by Śrīśailam Śatamakha Caturāmnāya Kumāra Tātayārya, the king's Guru in Vaiṣṇavism.
Mentioned in Kumāratātayāryavaibhavaprakāśikā by Kumāratātayārya's son Pāṭrācārya Veṅkaṭācārya. Pt.. Kumbakonam. [Page078-b]
Ascribed to his patron Raghunātha Nāyak, son of Acyutappa Nāyak in the Saṅgītasudhā, I. Intro., 62-63, an. the Sāhityaratnākara, VI, 36.
See Proceed. AIOC. Tirupati, p.. 181-2.

Acyutottara
a kāvya by Rāmaśarman; replete with verbal feats an. the use of rare an. numerous verbs.
ref. to by Bhāmaha in his K. A. II. 19. Ibid. II. 58 is a q. from Rāmaśarman.
